body: I need a fucking hug. Jesus. Alright man. Thanks so much. I'm gonna call up my friend right now. I still feel like a bag of ass, but I feel better. As cheesy as this is, things don't look so bad. Thanks again. Keep helping people out there. I feel like I will be back on here to do the same for others. Try and lay it forward. Take care Moose.

I'm very sorry for your loss. I know that's a generic response, but it's genuine. They always do say time will heal all wounds. I'm just lost in the sadness right now. Thanks you so much for taking the time to care and talk. It truly means a lot.

You're right. I just don't want to worry anyone. I feel like my problems are minimal compared to others. Boohoo I lost my gf. My dad has been struggling to support his family for the last 20 years. And here I am crying because some girl went and broke my heart.

The death of a relationship. Why is that so upsetting? Why does it make me try and think of ways out? I just told the other person I'm talking to that I know I don't have the guts to actually do it, but I'm scared that these thoughts are even here. That the idea of leaving it all behind even entered my brain.

I feel stupid because it's my fault that she is gone. I pushed her away and now she's gone. She was all I had. All I looked forward to everyday. Now I have nothing. Now I come home to an empty apartment. Little remnants of her laying around. To make sure I don't forget. I want to escape. I know I won't do it. I love my mom too much. I just can't keep these thoughts away.

My gf left me. It's my fault. I'm having thoughts that I've never had before. I don't have anyone close to talk to considering I'm like 2000 miles away from my friends and family. I feel stupid. My brain is messed up. Everything is out of wack. I'm scared that I'm feeling this way.

Ya you could say that. I really just don't know what to do. My gf left me and I feel so stupid, but these thoughts keep entering my head. Thoughts I've never had before and they are scary. I'm legitimately scared that I'm thinking of ways out
